data.long_meaning: Archit is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘archana’ meaning ‘to worship’. It is also associated with the god Agni, the god of fire, and the architect of the universe. The name symbolizes creativity, intelligence, and the power to shape and design one's own destiny. The name Archit carries the meaning “Lord of Measuring or Architect” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Archit usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of measuring or architect and live with faith, good character and purpose.

Context: Hindu mythology and ancient Indian literature
